findings: The public Land editor imports grouped-item and available-item query hooks from its CardColorBiomeModifier module.
The module defines GET /land/stake/items/{stakeTypeUid}/grouped and GET /land/stake/items/{stakeTypeUid}/available, passing remaining arguments as query parameters.
The Power Core editor uses stakeTypeUid STK-LND-PCR and both deedUid and player for both queries.
Grouped Power Core query uses offset=0, limit=1, order_by=1 (boost), order_by_asc=0 (descending). Available-ID query uses offset=0 and limit=1.
The editor reads the first grouped items entry and available ids. Client expectations are not a captured upstream response contract.
The same module defines the corresponding cards/{stakeTypeUid}/available and cards/{stakeTypeUid}/grouped queries.
limits: No account identifier was sent and no endpoint was called for this inspection.
Earlier empty/null captures remain valid historical observations. This evidence supersedes absence of client usage as a current finding, not the lack of populated wire evidence.
Availability, authentication behavior and populated row schema still need verification before tool binding.
